Films 'Awarapan 2' and 'Batwara 1947' Release, Pre-sales Compared

Two films, 'Awarapan 2' starring Emraan Hashmi and 'Batwara 1947' starring Sunny Deol, were released. Coverage indicates 'Awarapan 2' earned four times more than 'Batwara 1947' in pre-sales. The films mark a box office clash between Emraan Hashmi and Sunny Deol 19 years after a previous encounter. 'Awarapan 2' is described as a sequel featuring Emraan Hashmi as a grieving lover. 'Batwara 1947' stars Sunny Deol and Preity Zinta, with Bobby Deol also making an appearance.
